text_block_list.text:
I handed Maruzensky the mountain of fan 
mail that had arrived for her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, so many letters? It really makes me 
feel everyone's support♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. We've got some free time, so 
mind if I read through my fan letters?
choice_data_list: Of course, that's why I brought it.

Of course, that's why I brought it, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Now then, let's take a look...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"‘Her running style is just like a 
supercar, simply mesmerizing,’ it says. 
Oh, how lovely♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"‘Looking forward to your next race!’ 
Abso-lutely! I'll put on the best 
performance ever~!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'I absolutely love your 
songs, Maruzensky-san! I'm totally head 
over heels!'"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're head over heels for the 
cool, groovy me♪ I'm glad you enjoyed the 
concert so much~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think that's everything for now. 
That was delightful♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Every single letter is so heartfelt... It 
really makes me feel how much everyone is 
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't just want to run for myself, I 
want to run in a way that brings joy to 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my feelings are really 
getting through to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Don't you feel the same, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You feel the same way, right, 
Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna give it my all in the next 
race too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Running, singing, and dancing with all my 
joy... I'm gonna make everyone even mo~re 
head over heels for me!"
